Ms. Vinita Dwivedi, Advocate for the victim/complainant.
Heard on I.A. No.11159/2022, which is second application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of the appellant - Naveen.

Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 376 (2)(f)(i)(j) of IPC alongwith 3/4 and 5(m)(n)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences, Act and sentenced him to undergo RI for 14 years with fine of Rs.5,000/-, RI for 14 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and RI for 14 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations, vide judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 08.07.2015 passed by the 9th Additional Sessions Judge, Ujjain in S. T.
No.658/2014.
Appellant's first application for suspension of jail sentence was dismissed as withdrawn vide order 31.01.2017.
The victim/complainant has filed IA No.1979/2023 under Section 301(2) of Cr.P.C. pleading no objection, which is duly supported by an affidavit.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences, Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, on 19.10.2014, at about 6.30 PM, victim (PW-1), aged below 06 years was playing outside of her house, at that time, appellant came and took her to Kaaliyadeh Mahal by motorcycle and committed rape upon her.
When the victim started crying, the appellant had slapped and threatened her.
Appellant is uncle of the victim.
On 20.10.2014, an FIR (Exhibit-P/2) was lodged at police station Bherugarh, Ujjain on the basis of intimation given by mother of prosecutrix (PW-2).

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
Appellant is in custody since 20.10.2014.

Final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future therefore, on the ground of custodial period of appellant, it is prayed that the remaining sentence may be suspended and the appellant may be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State has objected the prayer of the appellant and submits that appellant is close relative of the victim and he has committed rape upon her.
At the time of incident, victim was below 06 years of age.
At the time of MLC, injuries were found on her private part as well as other parts of her body.
The victim has supported the case of the prosecution and her statement is supported by medical evidence as well as DNA report therefore, the application is liable to be rejected.

Learned counsel for the victim/complainant has supported the prayer of the appellant and submits that complainant party has compromised the matter with the appellant therefore, she has no objection in granting bail to the appellant.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
Considering the statement of victim (PW-1) and Dr. Jyoti Gedam (PW-4) and DNA report, at this stage, we are not inclined to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant.
IA No.11159/2022 is accordingly rejected.

IA No.1979/2023 stands disposed of.
 (S. A. DHARMADHIKARI) (PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA)
 JUDGE JUDGE  gp GEETA PRAMOD 2023.02.22 17:41:52 +05'30'
